title: Ark of the Covenant as a device that strikes people dead with fire
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Ark of the Covenant as a device that strikes people dead with fire, about biblical era at Sinai desert; Philistia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: according to the the Book of Exodus. But also, it strikes people dead with bolts of fire that come out of it.

plain: The Ark of the Covenant is the sacred chest that, in the Bible, the Israelites carried through the desert under Moses. A writer on ancient mysteries, Graham Hancock, points out on Jesse Michels's podcast that according to the Book of Exodus and other biblical passages, the Ark could also strike people dead with bolts of fire coming out of it. He tells it to suggest the Ark may have been some kind of powerful device rather than only a holy box.
